blocks.text: Sept. 23, 2026 | Families of some of Kenneth Law's victims share their pain on Day 1 of his sentencing hearing. A friend describes the shooting suspect's expressions of antisemitism before opening fire near a Belleville, Ont., synagogue. And a Winnipeg plasma clinic's license is pulled over safety issues after 2 donor deaths. Welcome to The National, the flagship nightly newscast of CBC News.
